narrative.details: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting $2oa Big Bronze Knife, along with information about delivery location and payment.  At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>
narrative.objectives: Acquire the items requested by the customer and deliver them to the location marked on your map. This writ must be in your possession to complete the transaction.
narrative.offerRewardText: Cluck? CLUCK CLUCK! BWOK! <The chicken glares menacingly toward Magus Tirth from afar, newly acquired blade in beak.>
narrative.requestItemsText: <The chicken... clears its throat?> Cluck, cluck.
